info.name: NRGMon - Solarman Battery Diagnostics
info.description: Read-only diagnostic requests matching collector/solarman.py. Requires a current Postman release with Web Crypto script support. Import this file, open collection Variables, and fill SOLARMAN_APP_ID, SOLARMAN_APP_SECRET, SOLARMAN_EMAIL, and your normal SOLARMAN_PASSWORD using local values. No credentials are included in this file. Send requests 1, 2, then 3. The login script hashes the exact UTF-8 password to lowercase SHA-256; do not paste an already-hashed password. Successful login saves a token for later requests. Station discovery selects a plant only when exactly one exists; otherwise enter SOLARMAN_STATION_ID yourself. SOLARMAN_ORG_ID is omitted when blank. Inspect response Body and Test Results to diagnose errors such as 2101025. Requests are manual: no hidden requests, retries, or automatic logins. The collector handles token refresh automatically; here rerun request 1 when needed. Do not share or commit a re-export containing credentials or captured tokens.
